Company Commercial Solicitor 3-5 years PQE Tunbridge Wells
Interesting commercial work, genuine autonomy and a firm where a long-term career can grow.
A highly regarded, community-focused firm is seeking a Company Commercial Solicitor for its Tunbridge Wells office.
Described as a lifestyle choice, this opportunity offers a friendly working environment, a strong local reputation and a commitment to looking after its people.
About the role
The Company Commercial Solicitor will work alongside an experienced senior lawyer, with legal assistant support.
Responsibilities include:
- Handling business sales and commercial agreements.
- Managing a varied company commercial caseload.
- Providing clear, practical advice and forming independent legal opinions.
- Progressing matters with limited day-to-day supervision, seeking senior input on more complex issues.
- Building strong client relationships while supporting the senior lawyer's focus on business development.
- Occasional travel to the firm's other offices.

What we are looking for
- A Company Commercial Solicitor with approximately 3-5 years' PQE.
- Experience in business sales and commercial agreements.
- Strong technical knowledge and sound commercial judgement.
- Confidence managing much of their caseload independently.
- The ability to recognise when guidance is needed.
- Excellent communication skills and a client-focused approach.
- An interest in growing with the firm over the longer term.

What's in it for you
- Target-related bonus scheme.
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays.
- Birthday off.
- Annual pay reviews.
- Private healthcare.
- Employee Assistance Programme.
- Death in Service cover and company pension.
- Hybrid working options, with flexible working requests considered subject to business needs.
- Ongoing training and development
- Local discount card.
- Social and charity events.
- Legal assistant support and opportunities to develop within the firm's long-term succession plans.

Working hours
- Monday to Thursday: 9am-5.30pm.
- Friday: 9am-5pm.

About the company
An established firm with five offices, an excellent local reputation and recognition through awards.
It's people describe the working environment as friendly, understanding and sociable. Community involvement and lasting client relationships are central to the firm's approach.
The firm is investing in talent from within, creating opportunities for lawyers who want to develop their expertise and contribute to its future leadership.

Contact Emma at TN Recruits Law today for a confidential conversation about this opportunity.

title: Family Legal Assistant
description:
Family Legal Assistant - Near Sevenoaks, Kent

Competitive Salary Free Parking Friendly, Family-Feel Firm

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Legal Assistant to join a well-established and highly regarded law firm based near Cranbrook.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a professional, friendly and supportive firm with a genuine family feel. Set within a beautiful working environment, the firm offers a welcoming culture, competitive salary and free parking.

The Role:

As a Legal Secretary, you will provide high-quality secretarial and administrative support to the firm's solicitors and wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Providing comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to solicitors
- Preparing and formatting legal correspondence and documentation
- Managing telephone calls, emails and client enquiries
- Diary management and arranging appointments and meetings
- Opening and maintaining client files
- Preparing documents and assisting with general file administration
- Liaising professionally with clients, colleagues and external contacts
- Supporting the smooth running of the department on a day-to-day basis

About You:

The successful candidate will ideally have previous experience within a legal secretarial or legal administrative role and will be confident working in a professional, client-focused environment.

You will be:
- Highly organised and detail-oriented
- Professional and personable
- An excellent communicator
- Able to manage your workload and prioritise effectively
- Reliable, proactive and hardworking
- Comfortable working as part of a close-knit and supportive team
- Experienced within a legal environment

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience
- Free parking
- Beautiful working environment
- Friendly and supportive family-feel culture
- Opportunity to join a well-established and respected law firm
- Excellent long-term career prospects

If you're an experienced Legal Assistant looking for your next opportunity with a friendly and professional firm where you will be genuinely valued, this could be the perfect role for you.

Apply now for immediate consideration.
